scripts.predev: npm run build -w @kittens/shared && npm run build -w @kittens/engine
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @kittens/server" "npm run dev -w @kittens/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kittens/shared && npm run build -w @kittens/engine && npm run build -w @kittens/server && npm run build -w @kittens/web
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @kittens/shared && npm run build -w @kittens/engine
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @kittens/shared && npm run build -w @kittens/engine
scripts.video:tutorial: npm run render -w @kittens/tutorial-video && npm run render:poster -w @kittens/tutorial-video
